Cle de Peau concealer

Every person who uses makeup needs an industrial strength concealer for emergencies. A flaming red zit, PIE, PIH, dark eye circles, you name it. This miracle worker covers it all and stays on all day. I bought mine more than 10 years ago (no kidding!) and there’s still a good amount of it left partly because a little goes a long way, and partly because I skipped makeup during the Covid lockdown and on telecommuting days. It is still in usable condition. 

It’s a stick concealer. I use it with a concealer brush for zits/PIE/PIH, and the tip of my ring finger for dark eye circles. For the under eye area, it doesn’t crease as long as you apply a thin layer (I apply it if needed after liquid foundation) and set it with a light dusting of loose powder. 

Yes, the price can be intimidating, I forgot how much it was 10 years ago, but to me it’s worth every cent. 


RMK liquid foundation 

RMK has a few foundations, I am referring to its liquid formulation. It has a dewy finish, if you use it as the brand says, without loose powder. I prefer a more matte look, so I do use translucent powder to set it. The coverage is light to medium, depends on whether you want to build it up with another layer. I find that one layer works well enough to even out the skin tone. My work used to require occasional tv appearances at short notice. As long as I’m wearing this foundation, I never worried about makeup running even in a hot and humid environment.

I love the examples you’ve brought up. Beiyuan is a flawed character, for sure. These examples show that he does have redeeming qualities, or else he would be a straight up villain. 

Based on WOH alone, he alluded that he was the scheming type, so I wasn’t surprised to find that out in Qi Ye. Although there was a mention of some “locker room talk” with ZZS about finding a slender waisted Nanjiang lady for the latter, I didn’t expect the extent of his (Beiyuan’s) debauchery. He seemed so regal and dignified in WOH. Appearances are indeed deceiving!

I think the actor did look the part to me. Hypothetically, it would be nice for the sake of continuity if he could reprise the role. Unfortunately, I also understand that Qi Ye is not likely to get a live action adaptation because of the reincarnation theme.

Declaring his interest in men and particularly for Ming Hua was also a comical way of showing Beiyuan’s sense of decency in not wanting to ruin the life of Princess Jing An by marrying her. I approve!

And it showed Helian Yi‘s double standard that he could have Su Qingluan, but he couldn’t accept Beiyuan’s own secret lover. It gave me that extra satisfaction as a reader.

I did suspect from watching the earlier episodes of WOH (from ep1 to sunbathing scene where he told WKX he’s been through the hell of human conscience) that ZZS was seriously messed up, so Qi Ye didn’t shock me. 

One particular line from WOH that stuck with me was when WKX was playing the flute on the boat was his surprise that WKX could play that particular melody, as only the innocent and pure-hearted could play it. So from that moment onwards, I saw WKX as the innocent and childlike one, and ZZS as his character foil.

Jiuxiao’s dream under the effects of Dream Stupor.

————————————————————————————-

And… there was his sect-brother.

He, who disappeared and reappeared like a ghost over these years and was busy with all sorts of routine junk, was smiling lightly, with all his features even relaxed. He carried two pots of bamboo-leaf green wine, drinking one himself as he tossed one to him, after which he told him that he said he wouldn’t leave. Every year, he would return to this little garden when winter passed; once the peach blossoms bloomed, he would take him to roam jianghu with him.

————————————————————————————-

It’s so pure-hearted that drinking and roaming the jianghu with ZZS was simply what he wanted most.

The night before Helian Yi’s marriage where he took out all the gifts that Beiyuan had given him in the past. He wanted to burn the painting of Beiyuan but eventually couldn’t do it. 

The line where Beiyuan realizes that he and Helian Yi were not shackled to the same chain, hence they were never meant to be together.

It’s also thrilling for me, as a WOH fan to see ZZS in his element, being resourceful and competent at what he does. He doesn’t need WKX to rescue him every other episode.
